name: MUSA-3
description: Third-generation robotic microsurgery platform for open super-microsurgery. The MUSA-3 translates a surgeon's hand movements into ultra-precise, tremor-free motions, enabling suturing of vessels as small as 0.3 mm. Features up to 20× motion scaling and proprietary tremor filtering. Uniquely, surgeons can use their own preferred standard microsurgical instruments from various brands via disposable adapters — no proprietary instruments required. Built on clinical experience from the MUSA and MUSA-2 platforms (first-in-human 2017, ~50 patient clinical studies). The system consists of a surgeon console with ergonomic joysticks and a robotic arm cart, both operating under a surgical microscope or 3D exoscope.
